title: Console create form (modal): the tab row derived from fieldGroups highlights the clicked tab but every group stays rendered, so tabs do not switch content
body:
## What happens

On a record **create** form opened as a modal in the Console, the form derived from the object's `fieldGroups` shows a tab row (one tab per group) **and** renders every group's section stacked underneath. Clicking a tab only moves the highlight; the content below does not change — all sections stay visible, in the same order, whichever tab is active.

Observed on a self-hosted runtime at platform **18.6.0**, zh-CN UI, object `crm_customer_rating` of a downstream metadata app. The object declares four `fieldGroups` (`basic`, `facts`, `result`, `legacy` — the last one `collapse: 'collapsed'`) and **no** authored form layout or `form.sections`; the layout is entirely derived. Screenshots show:

- tab row: 评级 · 事实数据 · 结果 · 旧标准事实（不再评分）, with 「事实数据」 highlighted after a click;
- below it, the 评级, 事实数据 and 结果 sections all rendered, and the collapsed 旧标准事实 group at the bottom — identical to the state with 「评级」 active.

## Expected

One of the two, consistently:

- the tab row switches content (only the active group's section is shown), **or**
- if the derived create form is meant to render all groups stacked, there is no tab row (or it is an anchor bar that scrolls to the section, with visible effect).

Showing both a tab row and all sections makes the tabs look broken to end users (reported by a customer demo user: 「切不了 tab 页」).

## Notes

- Not reproduced on the record detail page; only the create modal was observed. If the tabs are scroll anchors, the modal content may simply fit without scrolling, which would explain "nothing happens" — but then the tab row still misleads.
- No authored layout is involved, so this is the platform default form derivation.
